author: Patrick Cc:
description:
Jonah Hill is one of the greatest comedy stars of his generation, but his reputation off-screen was always a different story. Between constant media obsession over his weight, accusations of being difficult, and viral controversies surrounding his personal life, public opinion on him has always been divided. This video breaks down why Jonah Hill can’t seem to do anything right.. no matter which version of himself he tries to be.
